sasha: Heads up: reproduced a regression on Hosted where safetensors hot-init path falls back to full download when manifest omits byte_offset. Caused 3x cold-start latency. Stack snippet below.

sasha: ```
WARN loader hot-init fallback: manifest missing byte_offset -> initiating full fetch
Trace: weights_loader:hot_init -> fetch_blob -> http 200 -> mmap failed
```

maria: Can you drop a minimal repro + model id? We haven't seen missing byte_offset in safetensors manifests in our CI.

anil: I ran into something similar a while back with gzipped uploads where the index wasn't materialized. Idea: the loader should try a cheap header probe on the shard file to infer tensor offsets before triggering a full fetch.

devon: Would that require reading the whole file? We should only probe the first ~512 bytes. Most safetensors place tensor descriptors early, so a small sync/async read should be enough.

carla: Perf risk if we add a blocking read on every cold path. Suggest doing an async probe and writing the result to the local cache keyed by (model, shard-etag). Warmup will still prefer manifest when present.

anil: Prototype sketch (pseudo):
```python
# read small head, try parse tensor headers for offsets
head = read_bytes(blob, 0, 512)
if looks_like_safetensors_index(head):
    offsets = parse_offsets(head)
    return offsets
else:
    return None  # fall back to manifest or full fetch
```
I'll add unit tests for header shapes.

maria: Phased rollout plan: introduce a runtime flag `safetensors_compat_mode=probe-header` default OFF. Canary on Dedicated -> measure latency/extra IO -> then enable for Hosted if safe.

devon: Also consider adding a manifest schema extension `compat_level` so producers can advertise whether they wrote full index vs header-only. That avoids probing for newer artifacts.

carla: Implementation notes: cache header probes with TTL (24h) and invalidate on ETag change. Add metrics: `safetensors_header_probe_ms`, `safetensors_probe_hit` so we can quantify overhead. Also avoid sync disk reads in the hot path; prefer mmap or aio reads.

sasha: Sounds good. Who wants to own the loader patch + tests? I'll open an RFC follow-up and a ticket.

anil: I can prototype the loader change and add the regression test (gzipped shard without byte_offset in manifest). Will push a WIP PR.

prefetch-bot: Issue created: INF-1423 safetensors header probe + compat shim -> https://redwood.example/infr/INF-1423 :white_check_mark:

devon: :thumbsup: let's do the flag rollout plan
